This is first criminal appeal filed on behalf of the appellant under Section 14-A of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 for grant of bail against order dated 30.01.2023 passed by Special Judge, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
Tikamgarh passed in Bail Application No. 39/2023.
2. Appellant has been arrested on 15.01.2023 in connection with Crime No. 211/2022, registered at Police Station-Khargapur, District Tikamgarh (MP) for the offences punishable under Sections 363,

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that appellant was having love affair with prosecutrix.
Appellant is a teenager aged about 18 years and prosecutrix is aged about 16 years (15 years and 3 months).
It is submitted that investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
In these circumstances, he prayed that appellant may be enlarged on bail.
4 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the appeal.

It is submitted by him that offence under Section 5(L)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Section 3(1)(W) and 3(2)(5) of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 is made out against appellant.

sentences.text: There is clear allegations of rape on appellant.

In these circumstances,
appeal may be dismissed.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
6. Prosecutrix is aged about 15 years and 3 months and has entered in bracket of 16 years.
Appellant was having love relation with prosecutrix.
He is a young boy aged about 18 years.
If appellant is kept in jail for long time, he may turn into a criminal.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
Hence, this criminal appeal filed by appellant is allowed.

It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) by the appellant along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, the appellant be released on bail.

8. The appellant shall abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
9. C.C. as per rules.
